look_here_first: Start with sessile leaves and a long 3.5–12 cm axillary inflorescence. The key split from A. aphoroides is that A. simulans inflorescences are bisexual, then confirm with only 7–8 stamens.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: staminate flowers with 7–8 stamens and no staminodes

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: seeds 3.5–4.2 mm, faintly and irregularly alveolate

key_traits.label: Staminate flower
key_traits.text: Sepals 4–5.3 mm; petals 2–4 mm; 7–8 stamens; 0 staminodes. Petal attachment to the androphore is variable and not a safe binary.

key_traits.label: Pistillate flower
key_traits.text: Sepals 6–9 mm; styles 1.5–2.1 mm, glabrous; stigmas flattened

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Capsules 3.5–9 mm, hispidulous; seeds 3.5–4.2 mm, faintly and irregularly alveolate

lookalikes.differences: Use sessile leaves + long raceme to leave A. humilis behind, then use bisexual inflorescence + 7–8 stamens to separate from A. aphoroides.
